visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit at a white table in a dimly lit modern living room; the woman on the left wears a light green t-shirt with 'Pistachio' text, and the woman on the right wears a white polka-dot dress. They look expectantly toward the camera with excited facial expressions. (2) A cardboard box with 'SHARECO.' branding is placed on the table, and the woman in green tears open the tape with her hands, revealing a layer of transparent bubble wrap inside. (3) Both women reach into the box, pulling out pink rectangular perfume boxes and a plastic-wrapped poster featuring a female celebrity with long brown hair. (4) The camera zooms in as the woman in the white dress holds up a small photocard of the celebrity, while the woman in green examines the larger poster; a young child with a yellow towel wrapped around their head enters from the side. (5) They open the perfume boxes to reveal dark grey glass bottles; they apply the scent to their wrists and lean in to smell, laughing and smiling with high energy. (6) Close-up shots of two perfume bottles labeled 'KLOVER PANDOR' with sub-labels '1319 KISS MARK' and '1315 TABOO' appear, followed by the two women holding the bottles up toward the lens, smiling broadly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice introduces the scene with high energy over an upbeat synth-pop background music bed featuring a steady electronic drum kick. (2) A sharp ripping sound occurs as tape is removed from a box, accompanied by quick female vocal interjections and rising pitch. (3) Heavy rustling of plastic bubble wrap dominates the mix as multiple female voices overlap in an excited conversation about a celebrity. (4) The sound of stiff paper or cardstock being handled is audible as a child's voice briefly enters the acoustic field with a playful tone. (5) Audible inhalation and sniffing sounds occur as the women test the scent, followed by high-pitched laughter and expressive vocal exclamations. (6) A transition SFX leads into a final high-energy segment where multiple voices harmonize in a call to action over an intensified musical beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Unboxing -> Reveal -> Evaluation -> CTA
